summary: A worker asks trustees talking about longer opening hours to account for the people already covering vacancies.
realLife: At the November 2023 board meeting, a Boston library union president asked trustees to consider the burden on staff when discussing extending hours.
inGame: needs: public staffing comment and proposed hours.

turns.pulledBy: The proposed schedule fills the extra hours with new hires.
turns.what: The worker asks to see coverage by shift.
turns.writesBack: The board reply names the shifts that have coverage.

turns.pulledBy: The extra hours depend on existing staff staying late.
turns.what: The trustee requests the overtime estimate.
turns.writesBack: The operating proposal returns with its staffing cost visible.
